notes: Interaction data: node = GLB node name (or path from the model root, '/'-separated). axis = unit vector in the GLB frame (Y-up); origin_mm in mm in the GLB frame (CAD x, z, -y). 'after' lists what must be removed first. The same records are stored in node.extras.interact inside each GLB. Each fastener/lid/connector is a separate node; moving parts are never fused into shells.
